name: orb_plus_sector_filter_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, the 20-minute opening range (09:15-09:35) concentrates overnight information; false ORB breakouts occur when a single sector (IT, Energy) pushes NIFTY above the range while risk sentiment remains mixed. The differentiating signal is VIX ORB confirmation: as institutional buy programs overwhelm the opening range supply ceiling, option market makers simultaneously reduce hedging demand, causing India VIX to break below its own 20-minute opening range low. When NIFTY closes above its ORB high AND VIX simultaneously closes below its ORB low (dual-index ORB confirmation), the signal identifies broad-based institutional conviction — not a sector-specific spike — that carries NIFTY 20-30 spot points in 60-90 seconds. For the bearish case, NIFTY breaking its ORB low accompanied by VIX breaking its ORB high confirms synchronized fear escalation and institutional selling pressure.

indicators.name: nifty_orb_high
indicators.purpose: FIXED TIME WINDOW: 20-minute ORB is identical to the original strategy regardless of bar size. At 5s resolution, 240 bars = 20 minutes. Entry window starts at 09:35 once the ORB is fully formed. Same time window as the original — no scaling needed because this is a clock-based range, not a bar-count period.

indicators.name: nifty_orb_low
indicators.purpose: FIXED TIME WINDOW: same as orb_high. Symmetric counterpart for bearish breakdowns.

indicators.name: vix_orb_high
indicators.purpose: FIXED TIME WINDOW: VIX opening range high over the same 20-minute window. This is the 'sector index ORB' analog from the original — VIX is the broadest measure of cross-sector risk sentiment in NIFTY. VIX breaking its ORB high during a NIFTY down-breakout confirms multi-sector fear escalation (vs. a single-sector selloff that barely moves VIX).

indicators.name: vix_orb_low
indicators.purpose: FIXED TIME WINDOW: VIX opening range low over the same 20-minute window. VIX closing below this level during a NIFTY up-breakout means option market makers are reducing hedges broadly — confirming that the NIFTY rally has multi-sector institutional backing, not just an IT or FMCG spike.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.purpose: CUMULATIVE MEASURE — no scaling needed. VWAP-benchmarked algos dominate NIFTY intraday flow; close > VWAP at breakout time confirms that NIFTY has been net-bought all session, adding directional context. Acts as a secondary filter (the VIX ORB is the primary novel filter).

conditions: close > nifty_orb_high (NIFTY breaks above opening range)
vix_close < vix_orb_low (VIX breaks below its opening range low — broad fear dropping)
vix_close < vix_level_cap (not in extreme panic regime)
buy_ce.confirmation: Dual ORB: NIFTY breakout confirmed by VIX ORB breakdown (fear-falling confirmation mirrors original sector-index confirmation)

conditions: close < nifty_orb_low (NIFTY breaks below opening range)
vix_close > vix_orb_high (VIX breaks above its opening range high — broad fear rising)
vix_close < vix_level_cap (not in extreme panic where options are too expensive)
buy_pe.confirmation: Dual ORB: NIFTY breakdown confirmed by VIX ORB breakout (fear-rising confirmation mirrors original sector-index confirmation)

exit.stop_rationale: 5 option pts = ~10 NIFTY spot points (delta ~0.5). ORB breakouts with dual VIX confirmation should not retrace through the ORB level; a 10-spot-point drawback within 90 seconds indicates the breakout has failed and institutional flow has reversed. Tighter than deep-reversion stops (6 pts in vwap_mean_reversion_v18) because breakouts are directional continuation, not mean reversion needing room.
exit.target_rationale: 8 option pts = ~16 NIFTY spot points. ORB breakouts confirmed by VIX ORB typically extend 20-30 spot points in the first push (institutional order flow continuing partially unfilled); 8 pts captures ~60% of the median move at 1:1.6 R:R. Consistent with Example E (orb_momentum_v22) using 8 pts target for the same ORB continuation thesis.
exit.eod_rule: flatten at 14:00 IST — original used 14:00 cutoff

filters.vix_filter: vix_close < vix_level_cap (default 25.0) — prevents trading when extreme panic has inflated premiums beyond the cost model assumptions; above 25, ATM premiums spike and breakeven moves to 1.5+ pts
filters.time_filter: entry only 09:35-14:00 IST; requires both NIFTY and VIX ORBs fully formed (20 minutes = 240 bars)
filters.volume_filter: none — dual ORB confirmation (VIX alignment) replaces the volume filter from the original; VIX breaking its range is a stronger signal than volume threshold alone
filters.trend_filter: vwap direction (close vs vwap) as session trend confirmation
filters.spread_filter: not required — limit order execution at candle close, no bid-ask spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: low-medium — VIX-confirmed ORB is a multi-instrument signal; harder to arbitrage away than single-index ORB; decays if VIX behavior decouples from NIFTY index flow (structural regime change)

adaptation_notes: Original strategy: stock ORB + sector-index ORB confirmation. Key adaptation: the 'sector index' analog for NIFTY is India VIX (VIX = cross-sectional weighted implied vol of NIFTY options = a true multi-sector fear index). When NIFTY breaks its ORB high and VIX simultaneously breaks ITS ORB low, fear has dropped broadly — the rally has multi-sector institutional backing. This mirrors the original's sector-filter logic exactly: original checked if the BANKING sector index was also breaking out when a bank stock broke its ORB; this checks if broad market RISK SENTIMENT (VIX) is confirming the NIFTY breakout direction. The 20-minute ORB window is kept identical (not scaled) because it is a clock-based range — the same 09:15-09:35 window regardless of bar frequency. The trailing stop and sector-exit signal from the original are removed (incompatible with 5s trading). VWAP added as a secondary structural filter.
weaknesses: Dual ORB confirmation significantly reduces trade frequency; on high-VIX days, VIX rarely breaks below its own ORB low even during NIFTY up-breakouts
VIX ORB break may lag the NIFTY ORB break by 10-30 seconds — optimal entry can be missed
In strong trending markets where VIX declines all morning (like post-RBI dovish surprise), VIX ORB low is set very low and the signal may never fire despite valid NIFTY breakouts
Entry window ends at 14:00 — strategies with late-day breakouts are excluded
